CNN chief data analyst Harry Enten said there’s a simple reason Elon Musk and others are suddenly backpedaling away from President Donald Trump’s MAGA movement.

“I’ll tell you why he’s taking the ball and trying to run to the other side of the field. ... MAGA’s lowest net favorability rating ever, ever, ever, ever in October of 2026,” Enten said.

According to the latest numbers, MAGA net favorability is now 41 percentage points underwater ― and 61 points underwater among independent voters.

“My goodness gracious. Down there in the Gulf of Mexico,” Enten snarked. “No wonder he doesn’t want to be associated with MAGA. It is a brand that is failing amongst the American public.”

Enten pointed out that, in 2024, when Musk was bankrolling Trump and other MAGA candidates, the Republican Party’s net favorability rating was 14 points higher than that of the Democrats.

Musk bankrolled the GOP again this year ― but today, the Democrats are 17 points ahead of the Republicans in net favorability, as was also evident in this month’s midterm wipeout for MAGA, including candidates backed by Musk’s money.

Now, suddenly, Musk is trying to make nice with Democrats. This week, he denied being part of the MAGA movement, despite the fact that he fully embraced both Trump and his brand. And after making apocalyptic predictions about what would happen if the Democrats won in the midterm elections, he now claims he favors a divided government.

“Elon Musk is reading the tea leaves,” Enten said. “He’s no fool. He sees what’s going on. He saw the results just a few weeks ago. He sees the polling now. He wants nothing to do with a brand that he recognizes is, simply put, at this point towards the bottom and not towards the top. And that is why all of a sudden he wants to make friends with Democrats.”
